output_list.code: function mintToken(address target, uint256 mintedAmount) onlyOwner public {
output_list.reason: The mintToken function is designed to mint more tokens to a specified address. However, it does not check if the totalSupply exceeds the maximum supply. This could lead to token devalue, as the total supply of tokens is increased without any corresponding increase in the price of the token. The attacker can mint more tokens than the total supply of the token, and the price of the token will be reduced. This could be exploited by the token holder to sell the token at a loss.
